quotes.text: Save your customer's BLIK payment method while processing a payment for future recurring use.
This article has multiple variants. Fetch one of the following URLs to view specific content for your use case:

old_evidence.text: Before collecting the BLIK code, present the mandate terms to the customer
Not all Polish banks support BLIK recurring payments.
After the customer completes the Checkout Session, a reusable BLIK PaymentMethod is attached to the Customer.
After confirming with valid parameters, the PaymentIntent’s status becomes `requires_action`.
You must provide `mandate_data` with `customer_acceptance` set to `online`
Listen for the following webhooks to determine the outcome:

findings: New raw lines 5-15 are an index with Checkout, Elements and Direct API links and a short purpose sentence. The detailed paths, limits, schemes and outcomes in old raw lines 8-886 are absent from the pinned new body; this is navigation-only evidence, not proof of their removal, persistence in the live linked variants, or a substantive API change.

Current source lines 4-7 and 52-54 cite only the 2026-05-03 old raw; add the 2026-11-07 index provenance separately and keep all functional claims explicitly dated. Current source lines 13-50 already provide a useful old-capture summary and must not be overwritten with the shorter navigation page.

Old raw lines 8-12 require showing price, charge cycle, end date and terms link and getting agreement before collecting a BLIK code. Current source lines 13-21 mention banking-app mandate authorization and bank/PLN/amount limits but omit merchant presentation of terms; that prerequisite is material to the save-for-recurring flow.

Old raw lines 20-44 use Checkout Session payment mode, payment_intent_data.setup_future_usage off_session, and a Customer ID; lines 137-165 use a Customer and server-created PaymentIntent for Elements; lines 718-769 use a Customer and Direct API PaymentIntent with online mandate acceptance ip_address/user_agent and BLIK code. Current source lines 23-37 separate those path settings correctly, but should make clear that the Direct API mandate_data requirement is path-specific.

Old raw lines 607-613 and 773-800 distinguish requires_action/next_action.blik_authorize, a 60-second bank-app payment-plus-mandate action, and later webhook-confirmed outcomes. Old raw lines 627-660 and 814-847 use a new later PaymentIntent with saved PaymentMethod, Customer, off_session and confirm; the bank validates the original mandate and a decline can return requires_payment_method. Current source lines 31-42 omit the final-status webhook boundary and could imply bank action equals success.

Old raw lines 74-75, 653-656 and 840-843 state PLN only and a 2000 PLN ceiling per off-session recurring payment. Old raw lines 83-118, 662-699 and 849-886 give six recurring-specific sandbox email patterns with differing delay and event/decline outcomes; current source lines 44-50 preserve the patterns but not their distinct failure-code versus mandate.updated event identities.

Related primary BLIK raw raw/stripe-blik-2025.md lines 30-32 says recurring payments Yes (Private preview), and wiki/concepts/stripe-blik.md lines 25-30 preserves that scope. The current save-during-payment source lines 13-20 omits this dated availability qualifier; add a reciprocal qualification without asserting present account eligibility from the November index.

Old raw lines 392-419 give Elements a generic stripe.confirmPayment return_url example; lines 607 and 773-794 describe the BLIK-specific in-app action, while wiki/concepts/stripe-blik.md lines 10 and 23 says BLIK itself has no redirect. The current source line 31 should not be read as a BLIK redirect guarantee; keep the generic return_url and BLIK action distinct.

Old raw line 488 says 'the card is saved' inside the BLIK Elements variant, an internal copy/template error beside BLIK-specific lines 8, 153-165, 607 and 627-631. Preserve the contradiction as a warning rather than claiming card storage is a BLIK behavior.
historical_claims_to_preserve: 2026-05-03 old raw lines 8-12: BLIK code and mandate authorization are approved in banking app, terms including price/cycle/end date/link must be presented before code collection, and unsupported banks can decline.

2026-05-03 old raw lines 20-44: Checkout Session in payment mode with payment_intent_data.setup_future_usage off_session, Customer ID and hosted flow; after completed Session, reusable BLIK PaymentMethod attaches to Customer.

2026-05-03 old raw lines 137-165, 390-392, 607-613: Elements uses server PaymentIntent plus client Payment Element/stripe.confirmPayment, then bank action and asynchronous payment-status verification.

2026-05-03 old raw lines 718-794: Direct API PaymentIntent includes PLN, Customer, setup_future_usage off_session, BLIK code, online mandate_data with ip_address/user_agent and confirm true; requires_action/next_action.blik_authorize is not completion.

2026-05-03 old raw lines 46-79, 627-660, 814-847: later off-session confirmed PaymentIntent with saved PaymentMethod and Customer, bank validation, final-status webhooks, PLN-only, 2000 PLN ceiling and requires_payment_method on decline.

2026-05-03 old raw lines 81-118, 662-699, 849-886: six recurring-specific sandbox patterns differentiate immediate and delayed provider decline, mandate.updated transitions and subsequent off-session failure.
Separate 2026-05-03 primary BLIK raw raw/stripe-blik-2025.md lines 30-32 calls recurring support private preview; it is dated historical eligibility context, not verified current access.
conflicts: Old raw line 488 says a 'card' is saved in the Elements BLIK variant, conflicting with its surrounding BLIK PaymentMethod/Customer and mandate descriptions in old raw lines 8, 153-165, 607, 627-631. Retain a dated warning; do not reproduce the card claim as fact.

Old raw lines 392-419 offer a generic stripe.confirmPayment return_url and discuss redirection of some payment methods, while BLIK-specific old raw lines 607 and 773-794 plus wiki/concepts/stripe-blik.md lines 10,23 describe in-app bank approval/no BLIK redirect. Avoid implying BLIK uses a browser redirect.

Current source lines 13-50 explain the save flow but omit the dated primary BLIK private-preview qualification (raw/stripe-blik-2025.md lines 30-32; concept lines 25-30); include the scope warning reciprocally without treating the November index as eligibility evidence.
unresolved_questions: The November 2026 Checkout, Elements and Direct API variant bodies linked by new raw lines 11-15 were not captured, so their current instructions, feature availability and bank participation are unverified.

source_assessments.reason: The semantic raw delta is navigation-only. A source correction is needed for new provenance plus material omitted consent, dated eligibility and outcome boundaries, while preserving accurately summarized May 2026 path details.

answers.Q1: At https://docs.stripe.com/payments/blik/save-during-payment, new raw lines 5-15 establish only the save-during-payment purpose and navigation to Checkout, Elements and Direct API; they do not document variant-body prerequisites or success. The dated old raw lines 8-44, 137-165, 607-660 and 718-847 require mandate terms before code entry, a Customer and reusable PaymentMethod, and path-specific Checkout Session or PaymentIntent setup_future_usage. Direct API includes online mandate_data and a BLIK code; bank-app payment-plus-mandate approval follows requires_action, and a later off-session PaymentIntent has separate outcome verification. source-stripe-blik-save-during-payment.md captures most paths and PLN/2000-PLN limits but omits terms-before-code, the dated private-preview qualification, and final webhook status boundary.
answers.Q2: For https://docs.stripe.com/payments/blik/save-during-payment, new raw lines 9-15 are navigation-only; the missing variant bodies do not substantiate a behavioral change from old raw lines 8-886. source-stripe-blik-save-during-payment.md should retain the May 2026 Checkout, Elements and Direct API instructions, six sandbox cases, PLN limit, 2000-PLN off-session ceiling and bank-support caveat as dated history. The old Elements 'card' sentence at old raw line 488 conflicts with the BLIK-specific method, and generic return_url text at old raw lines 392-419 does not establish a BLIK browser redirect. The related primary BLIK page dated May 2026 labels recurring private preview. A requires_action response, bank prompt, or created later PaymentIntent is not payment success; webhooks determine final status, and the November links do not verify current eligibility.
